# lsblk -P -o NAME,PATH,TYPE,FSTYPE,MOUNTPOINT,SIZE,LABEL,PARTLABEL,PARTUUID,UUID,RM
# A representative rig, captured from this machine, plus the rows a real rig
# grows over time: a removable USB backup drive mounted at a mountpoint with a
# space in it, a removable USB partition, a snap squashfs loop device, swap on
# zram, an optical drive, an unformatted Microsoft reserved partition, and the
# unmounted Windows slices on the second drive.
# The btrfs system partition (nvme1n1p5) is mounted as several subvolumes; lsblk
# reports it once, at whichever mountpoint it picked.
